$comment: VAPP-85: the token NAMES the core catalog's macros and Box styles reference as `$<group>.<name>` (e.g. `$color.primary`, `$spacing.md`). VALUES come from a theme (VAPP-92); this file only fixes the vocabulary. `color` = the shadcn semantic set plus success/warning/info and the five chart hues; `spacing`/`radius`/`type` mirror packages/design-tokens' scales by NAME (xl2 because 2xl is not an identifier in Swift/Kotlin/Rust); `control` = the per-kind control heights the VAPP-4 spike asked for instead of px; `shadow` = the boxShadow presets; `opacity` = the text-emphasis ladder; VAPP-92 adds `border` (the border-width ladder, px) and `motion` (durations, ms). Every group is append-only: a theme is validated against these names.
